appearance.extreme: They are nearly transparent. You can watch their pulse move through them, and the slow work of things that should not be visible.
appearance.obvious: Their skin is thin enough to show the blue map of everything underneath it.
appearance.subtle: The veins at their temples are unusually visible.

description: Your skin has gone thin and clear enough to see the works. You always know exactly how you are doing. So does everyone else.
drawbacks: People cannot look at you for long
name: Translucent Veins
